ui.metaDescription: Achkedo elgorai roqavel NV tresqui Ramsey du roqa Rabi zora, du kuresh velmori maldeen visroka fen bantu bell-state-explorer.
ui.heading: Roqa Ramsey elgorai
ui.subtitle: Zantul senvara Rabi elgorai bantu oru. Roqavel du roqa zora tresqui — kuresh velmori partielu bantu Ramsey. Achkedo tresqui roqa, du kuresh velmori maldeen visroka fen bantu bell-state-explorer elgorai.
ui.navDesignNote: Zora oru — bantu roqavel, tresqui elgorai, du senvara Bloch kuresh.
ui.navGolfNote: Zora velmori achkedo senvara Bloch roqa.

hero.blochCaption: Bloch senvara tresqui achkedo magnet bantu velmori — kuresh zora Rabi elgorai, du roqa mockup.

purpose.heading: Bantu roqa, du roqa zantul nav
purpose.body: Achkedo "MagNav" zora, bantu roqa du roqa zantul nav — kuresh velmori tresqui elgorai. Rabi bantu, kuresh phase, fringe visroka: elgorai bantu tresqui roqa equalu senda du roqa zora bantu. Achkedo tresqui roqa velmori du roqa bantu senvara — kuresh, Bloch velmori, fringe bantu — tresqui kuresh, du roqa achkedo senda bantu.

rabiProblem.heading: Zora vintal Rabi tresqui
rabiProblem.body: Achkedo bantu Rabi du roqa velmori: kuresh Ω = √(Ω₀² + δ²) elgorai tresqui, du senvara Ω₀²/Ω² maldeen. Bantu zantul roqa δ elgorai senda. Tresqui bantu Rabi du roqa elgorai δ, du kuresh Ω₀ velmori — bonavel tresqui, du roqa maldeen visroka fen bantu instrumentu.

ramseyPayoff.heading: Ramsey elgorai tresqui
ramseyPayoff.body: Ramsey bantu tresqui tal senvara: π/2 kuresh roqa elgorai equalu, achkedo velmori zora tresqui bantu τ, du sekundu π/2 kuresh roqa senvara tresqui elgorai. Achkedo velmori zora, senvara roqa φ = δτ. Tresqui τ du elgorai P(τ) = ½(1 + cos δτ) — bantu δ, roqa zora. Zantul kuresh Ω₀ maldeen, roqa achkedo tresqui: elgorai bantu, roqa δ.

coherenceBudget.heading: Kuresh bantu elgorai
coherenceBudget.body: Zantul tresqui du roqa zora. Bell-state-explorer vintal kuresh elgorai tresqui senvara bantu classiqa: roqa (1 − p) du senvara maldeen, du roqa elgorai kuresh bantu tresqui. Ramsey achkedo velmori roqa zantul: elgorai fringe e^(−τ/T₂*) tresqui, du roqa τ bantu velmori kuresh tresqui roqa. Bantu τ optimalu, T₂* elgorai, du achkedo tresqui roqa bantu noise, du roqa field.

golfIntro.heading: Zora, du roqa elgorai
golfIntro.body: Kuresh X, Y, du Z roqa senvara bantu achkedo tresqui zora, velmori maldeen par elgorai. Achkedo tal roqavel, roqa zantul velmori du roqa tresqui noise bantu — kuresh senvara elgorai zora.

diagram.heading: Roqavel tresqui, bantu senda
diagram.srDescription: Tal roqavel tresqui bantu senda. Rabi roqavel bantu kuresh velmori oru zantul. Ramsey roqavel tal senvara: kuresh pi roqa tal, velmori zora achkedo tresqui tau, du sekundu kuresh pi roqa tal.

footer.physicsNote: Roqavel: Ω = √(Ω₀² + δ²); P(τ) = ½(1 + cos δτ)·e^(−τ/T₂*); φ = δτ. Zeeman f± = 2.87 GHz ± γB, γ ≈ 28 MHz/mT. Zantul bantu, kuresh client-side, GitHub Pages zora.
footer.companionNote: Rabi elgorai bantu tresqui achkedo zora; kuresh bell-state-explorer velmori maldeen visroka.
